## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与商业流程）

### 1. 关键财务数据（Q4）

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | 同比变化 (GAAP) | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营收 | $37,847M | $33,112M | +14% (+14% cc) | press_release.txt；financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 营业成本 | $6,989M | $6,042M | +15.7% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $8,958M | $8,077M | +10.9% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润 | $21,900M | $18,993M | +15.3% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润率 | 57.9% | 57.3% | +0.6pp | 推算：$21,900 / $37,847（transcript 原文 "operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%"） |
| 毛利率（美元） | — | — | +14% (+13% cc) | transcript.md Amy Hood："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency" |
| 毛利率（%） | 下降 | — | 微降 | transcript.md："gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage" |

### 2. 增长驱动因素（原文引用）

- **Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud**：调整后 +16%（报告口径 +14%）。Amy Hood 在电话会指出："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition."（transcript.md）
- **M365 Commercial 产品收入**：+19%，"driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component"（transcript.md）
- **M365 Consumer cloud**：+24%（cc +22%），"again driven by ARPU growth…subscriptions grew 7%"（transcript.md）
- **LinkedIn**：+12%（cc +10%），"primarily driven by Marketing Solutions"（transcript.md）
- **Dynamics 365**：+13%（cc +12%），"against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles"（transcript.md）

## 三、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

|---|---|---|---|---|

| 营业成本 | $16,876M | $11,845M | +42.5% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $6,475M | $5,893M | +9.9% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润 | $15,955M | $12,140M | +31.4% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润率 | 40.6% | 40.7% | -0.1pp | 推算；transcript.md："operating margins…were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%" |
| 毛利率（美元） | — | — | +24% | transcript.md："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24%" |
| 毛利率（%） | 下降 | — | — | transcript.md："gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure" |

### 2. 增长驱动因素（原文引用）

- **Azure and other cloud services**：+43%。"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity…also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value"（transcript.md Amy Hood）
- **On-premises server**："revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency…ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"（transcript.md）
- 经营费用 +10%，"driven by the shared R&D investments"（transcript.md）

## 四、分部三：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

| 指标 | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | 同比变化 (GAAP) | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营收 | $12,854M | $13,451M | -4% (-5% cc) | press_release.txt；financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 营业成本 | $5,660M | $6,127M | -7.6% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | $4,446M | $4,134M | +7.5% | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |

| 经营利润率 | 21.4% | 23.7% | -2.3pp | 推算；transcript.md："operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%" |
| 毛利率（美元） | — | — | -2% | transcript.md："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2%" |
| 毛利率（%） | 上升 | — | — | transcript.md："gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition" |

### 2. 下滑驱动因素（原文引用）

- **Windows OEM and Devices**：-7%（Windows OEM -5%）。"driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support"（transcript.md）
- **Xbox content and services**：-10%。"against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance"（transcript.md）
- **Search advertising ex-TAC**：+10%（cc +9%）。"growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships"（transcript.md）
- 经营费用 +8%，"driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX"（transcript.md）
- Satya Nadella 在电话会表示："we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth…expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027"（transcript.md）

## 五、全公司合计验证（勾稽）

| 项目 | 分部相加 (Q4 FY26) | 全公司合计 (Q4 FY26) | 差异 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 营收 | 37,847 + 39,306 + 12,854 = **90,007** | 90,007 | 0 | financial_statements.txt Segment Results + Income Statements |
| 营业成本 | 6,989 + 16,876 + 5,660 = **29,525** | 29,525 | 0 | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 + 6,475 + 4,446 = **19,879** | 19,879 | 0 | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 + 15,955 + 2,748 = **40,603** | 40,603 | 0 | financial_statements.txt Segment Results |

**结论：三个分部之和与全公司合计在营收、成本、费用、经营利润四个科目上完全勾稽，误差为 0。**

全公司同比验证：营收 $90,007M vs $76,441M = +18% ✔；经营利润 $40,603M vs $34,323M = +18% ✔（press_release.txt）。

## 七、口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部 vs 合并口径**：三个分部之和与全公司合计完全勾稽（见第五节），因此所有全公司数字均可由分部加总还原。但**毛利率百分比、经营利润率**等"比率型"指标**不可**直接由分部数字加总还原，须用全公司合并口径计算。

2. **分部毛利率与经营利润率口径差异**：
   - 分部经营利润率 = 分部经营利润 / 分部营收（本报告采用）；
   - 全公司经营利润率 = 全公司经营利润 / 全营收（45.1%），与分部利润率加权平均**不等**（因分部营收权重不同）。

3. **成本与费用的归集**：
   - **营业成本（Cost of revenue）**：在分部层面披露，包含产品成本与服务成本；
   - **经营费用（Operating expenses）**：在分部层面披露，包含 R&D + Sales & Marketing + G&A 的分部归属部分，但**共享 R&D** 在分部间的拆分不在本材料明细披露（transcript.md 仅笼统提及"shared R&D investments"）。

4. **Non-GAAP 与 GAAP**：本报告所有分部数字均为 GAAP 口径；Non-GAAP 调整项（OpenAI 投资影响 $480M 净收益）仅出现在公司合并层面，未拆分至分部。

5. **"同比"比较基础**：本报告所有同比变化均相对于 FY25 Q4（2025 年 7 月 1 日 – 2026 年 6 月 30 日），即同口径"对应期间"。

6. **恒定汇率（Constant Currency）**：仅当汇率波动影响显著时公司在 press_release.txt 与 metrics.txt 中同时披露 GAAP 与 CC 增速；两版本差异通常在 1pp 以内。

7. **跨分部不可直接比较的内容**：
   - 各分部营收增速差异极大（IC +32% vs MPC -4%），受各自业务结构、基数、周期影响；
   - MPC 的毛利率% 上升系 Activision 并购摊销减少所致（transcript.md），不可类推到其他分部；
   - PPB 与 IC 毛利率% 下降均因"销售结构转向 Azure"（sales mix shift），但 IC 还要叠加 AI 基础设施前置投资。

8. **分部历史数据**：financial_statements.txt 的 Segment History 工作表包含 FY25 Q1–Q4 与 FY26 Q1–Q3 完整序列，本报告仅聚焦 Q4 FY26；如需趋势分析可进一步提取。

---

**数据出处汇总**：
- press_release.txt：全公司合并营收/利润/分部营收/增长率/Business Highlights
- financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表：分部营收、成本、费用、经营利润（Q4 与全年）
- financial_statements.txt → Income Statements 工作表：全公司合并损益
- transcript.md：Amy Hood 与 Satya Nadella 全部电话会陈述（分部毛利率方向、驱动因素、增速口径说明）
- metrics.txt：关键 KPI 同比增速表（含 GAAP 与恒定汇率双口径）
- products & services 历史（Products & Services History 工作表）：细分产品收入（补充参考）
